title: ABINIT basic3 crystalline-silicon tutorial
status_detail: Exact ABINIT 10.8.3 two-dataset silicon SCF-and-bands input, pseudopotential, resources, output roles, and workspace are staged as one side of a same-simulation QE pair; execution awaits checkpoint PAIRED-SILICON-BANDS-RUN-HC01 while other basic3 stages remain blocked.
objective: Inspect, represent as software examples, separately reproduce when authorized, or explicitly defer ABINIT basic3 silicon total-energy, k-point convergence, lattice-parameter, and Kohn--Sham band stages.
authorized_scope: Inventory basic3 input datasets, silicon pseudopotential, k-point grids, lattice optimization, SCF-to-NSCF transfer, band path, outputs, and optional AbiPy steps.
Map stages to the existing QE silicon SCF, convergence, structure-optimization, and bands Tasks without asserting aligned inputs or results.
If separately authorized, execute only explicitly selected ABINIT stages in isolated workspaces with separate streams and artifact inventories.
completion_criteria: Every represented ABINIT stage has explicit inputs, units, coordinate and k-point conventions, dependencies, and output roles.
The QE correspondence identifies both shared workflow structure and all known prerequisites for a future aligned comparison.
Kohn--Sham eigenvalues and tutorial lattice or gap observations retain explicit tutorial-only claim boundaries.
exclusions: No ABINIT or AbiPy execution, further dependency change, or pseudopotential acquisition occurs without separate authority.
The ABINIT and QE tutorial values are not directly subtracted or compared before physical and numerical alignment.
No tutorial cutoff, k-mesh, lattice parameter, band count, path, or tolerance becomes a production setting.
